note: Declared inputs of the engineering self-host workflow (tests/selfhost). Identities only; machine-local paths are supplied at run time. The normative source-set manifest is bootstrap/source-set.toml; its file list must equal source_set.files here (the v4 qualification checks this).

smc.role: C0 compiler, sm-verify and sm-vm (smc-cli built from the C0 SHA). source_fingerprints_allowed: what `smc version --json` reports for builds of the C0 SHA (605bf55cab818ec5 from a CRLF checkout, the pinned binary; 1ba2e126545f26ce from an LF checkout). Other C0 binaries are accepted only with --reproduction-build, which never yields a contract record.

executor.role: Bootstrap Contract v4 executor: smc-cli built from the admitted upstream revision; `smc run-smc --expect-sha256` admits and executes a stored SemCode artifact under the trusted-compiler envelope. The source fingerprint is what `smc version --json` reports for that revision; builds embed their path, so other binaries are accepted only with --reproduction-build.

driver.role: rev5 stored-exec-driver 0.3.2 (engineering only): the program the optional S2 harness path wraps; not the v4 executor

s2_harness.note: Production (no test-hooks) s2-harness built from the published head 7bdbe2a of skulmakov-oss/s2-harness Draft PR #1 (fresh default clone; recorded in evidence package S2_V02_PR_PUBLICATION_01, raw/build/F_7bdbe2a_default_crlf_t4.binary_hashes.txt). Builds embed their path, so any other build is a different identity and must be pinned explicitly.
